name: The Bandit Camp
summary: Bandits have made camp in the forest south of the road. Break them.

objectives.text: Break the bandit camp in the forest at 6,12.

name: The Surveyor
summary: A royal surveyor needs safe conduct east along the road.

objectives.name: Surveyor Tamsin
objectives.text: Bring Surveyor Tamsin safely to Eastmarch.

name: Letters for Highcairn
summary: Carry sealed letters to the warden at Highcairn.

name: The Old Watchtower
summary: Something has moved into the ruined watchtower in the hills. Find it and deal with it.

objectives.text: Find the old watchtower in the hills at 12,2.
Drive out whatever holds the watchtower.

name: The Barrow-King's Torc
summary: Something guards the Old Barrow's lower hall, and the barrow-king's torc lies hidden above it. Bring the torc back.

objectives.text: Go down to the lower barrow.
Destroy the guardians in the east hall of the lower barrow.
Find the barrow-king's torc in a hidden room of the upper barrow.

name: The Pilgrimage to Highcairn
summary: A pilgrim must reach the hill shrine at Highcairn. See them there safely, and the temple will raise one of your dead.

objectives.name: a pilgrim
objectives.text: Bring the pilgrim safely to Highcairn.

name: The Saint's Finger-Bone
summary: A saint's finger-bone lies among the heaped bones of the lower barrow. Bring it back, and the temple will raise one of your dead.

objectives.text: Find the saint's finger-bone among the bones of the lower barrow.

name: The Pilgrimage to Westhold
summary: A pilgrim must reach the temple at Westhold. See them there safely, and the shrine will raise one of your dead.

objectives.name: a pilgrim
objectives.text: Bring the pilgrim safely to Westhold.

name: The Corpse-Thieves
summary: Corpse-thieves are digging up the roadside graves south-east of town. Stop them, and the shrine will raise one of your dead.

objectives.text: Stop the corpse-thieves at the graves at 21,10.

name: The Pilgrimage to Eastmarch
summary: A pilgrim must reach the shrine at Eastmarch. See them there safely, and the hill priest will raise one of your dead.

objectives.name: a pilgrim
objectives.text: Bring the pilgrim safely to Eastmarch.

name: The High Cairn
summary: Climb to the old cairn above the town and lay a stone on it. Come back, and the hill priest will raise one of your dead.

objectives.text: Lay a stone on the high cairn at 17,1.
